dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: The search-and-rescue team hasn't had news of her yet. But please don't panic... This isn't the time to panic just yet.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: We should have news of her shortly.

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: As for me, I believe that she's still alive. Adventurers are a tough lot, so she shouldn't... Um, sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Muning
dialogues.text: *cough* But if you do meet her out there, please be sure to tell me.
